    def register_proposal(self, proposal: ProposalRecord) -> ProposalRecord:
        # Import-facing registration: untrusted advisory material only. New
        # rows start pending with no operator approval, shares, or execution.
        # A legit unchanged duplicate returns the actual ledger row (preserving
        # any chosen quantity/approval); rejected/simulated rows are immutable.
        # If research terms/identity change while nonterminal, reset local
        # approval/shares/execution to pending with a freshly computed version.
        nonterminal = (
            ProposalStatus.PENDING_REVIEW.value,
            ProposalStatus.APPROVED.value,
        )
        terms_unchanged = (
            \"proposals.run_id = excluded.run_id\"
            \" AND proposals.ticker = excluded.ticker\"
            \" AND proposals.trade_date = excluded.trade_date\"
            \" AND proposals.signal = excluded.signal\"
            \" AND proposals.rating IS excluded.rating\"
            \" AND proposals.side = excluded.side\"
            \" AND proposals.price IS excluded.price\"
            \" AND proposals.evidence_id IS excluded.evidence_id\"
        )
        with self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                f\"\"\"INSERT INTO proposals
                   (id, run_id, ticker, trade_date, signal, rating, side, price,
                    shares, evidence_id, status, proposal_version, operator,
                    created_at, approved_at, approved_version, reason, execution_json)
                   VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?,?,?,NULL,?,NULL,NULL,?,NULL)
                   ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
                     run_id = excluded.run_id,
                     ticker = excluded.ticker,
                     trade_date = excluded.trade_date,
                     signal = excluded.signal,
                     rating = excluded.rating,
                     side = excluded.side,
                     price = excluded.price,
                     evidence_id = excluded.evidence_id,
                     status = excluded.status,
                     proposal_version = excluded.proposal_version,
                     reason = excluded.reason,
                     shares = NULL,
                     operator = NULL,
                     approved_at = NULL,
                     approved_version = NULL,
                     execution_json = NULL
                   WHERE proposals.status IN (?,?)
                     AND NOT ({terms_unchanged})\"\"\",
                (
                    proposal.proposal_id, proposal.run_id, proposal.ticker,
                    proposal.trade_date, proposal.signal, proposal.rating,
                    proposal.side, proposal.price, proposal.evidence_id,
                    ProposalStatus.PENDING_REVIEW.value,
                    make_proposal_version(
                        proposal.ticker,
                        proposal.trade_date,
                        proposal.signal,
                        proposal.price,
                        side=proposal.side,
                        evidence_id=proposal.evidence_id,
                    ),
                    proposal.created_at, proposal.reason,
                    *nonterminal,
                ),
            )
        existing = self.get_proposal(proposal.proposal_id)
        if existing is not None:
            return existing
        return proposal

    def get_proposal(self, proposal_id: str) -> ProposalRecord | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            \"SELECT * FROM proposals WHERE id=?\", (proposal_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return self._row_to_proposal(row)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)


def material_evidence_id(
    ticker: str, trade_date: str, input_snapshot: InputSnapshot
) -> str:
    \"\"\"Stable SHA-256 identity of the material evidence for a proposal.

    Derived only from logical inputs (ticker, trade date and material
    ``InputSnapshot`` data), so it is identical on creation and import,
    independent of JSON key ordering, secret sanitization and run IDs.
    \"\"\"
    import hashlib

    payload = {
        \"ticker\": str(ticker).upper(),
        \"trade_date\": str(trade_date),
        \"identity\": input_snapshot.identity,
        \"data_snapshot\": input_snapshot.data_snapshot,
        \"available_sources\": input_snapshot.available_sources,
        \"memory_used\": input_snapshot.memory_used,
        \"memory_sources\": input_snapshot.memory_sources,
    }
    return hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json(payload).encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()

def sanitize_secrets(obj: Any, _key: str = \"\") -> Any:
    \"\"\"Recursively redact credential-looking keys so packs never hold secrets (SEC-001).

    Actual Pydantic models -- including LangChain ``HumanMessage``,
    ``AIMessage`` and ``ToolMessage`` values nested in graph state -- are
    converted to JSON-native dicts via their ``model_dump(mode=\"json\")`` API
    before redaction. Their type, content, tool calls, tool call id,
    additional kwargs, response metadata and usage metadata therefore survive
    export/import intact while any credential fields inside them are still
    redacted. Messages are never stringified.
    \"\"\"
    if isinstance(obj, BaseModel):
        return sanitize_secrets(obj.model_dump(mode=\"json\"), _key)
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        out = {}
        for k, v in obj.items():
            if _is_credential_key(str(k)):
                out[k] = \"**REDACTED**\" if v not in (None, \"\") else v
            else:
                out[k] = sanitize_secrets(v, _key)
        return out
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [sanitize_secrets(v, _key) for v in obj]
    return obj

class InputSnapshot(BaseModel):
    \"\"\"The material inputs a run consumed, so a rerun can be replayed.\"\"\"

    instrument_context: str = \"\"
    past_context: str = \"\"
    initial_state: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    identity: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    data_snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = Field(
        default_factory=dict
    )  # tool_name -> {\"canonical args key\": result text}
    memory_used: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    memory_sources: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # Factual *available* corpus for the case (identity, full market CSV, official
    # news notes) recorded separately from the tool calls actually made. This is
    # what makes the evidence-derived price available for proposal/replay even
    # when a model path did not ask one of the data tools.
    available_sources: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
